<target>## **37.5. Additional Standard Unprivileged Extension Names**

Standard unprivileged extensions can also be named by using a single "Z" followed by an alphanumeric name. The name must end with an alphabetical character. The second letter from the end cannot be numeric if the last letter is "p". For example, "Zifencei" names the instruction-fetch fence extension described in Chapter 5.

The first letter following the "Z" conventionally indicates the most closely related alphabetical extension category, IMAFDQLCBKJTPVH. For the "Zfa" extension for additional floating-point instructions, for example, the letter "f" indicates the extension is related to the "F" standard extension. If multiple "Z" extensions are named, they should be ordered first by category, then alphabetically within a category—for example, "Zicsr_Zifencei_Ztso".

All multi-letter extensions, including those with the "Z" prefix, must be separated from other multiletter extensions by an underscore, e.g., "RV32IMACZicsr_Zifencei".</target>
